world.title: 缩小一片叶隙，让树荫落满一百个太阳
world.posterTitle: 树荫下，为什么落着一地小太阳？
world.posterHook: 让月球咬住太阳，再缩小叶片缝隙：上百个模糊圆斑会同时变成清晰的金色月牙。
world.posterSource: Canvas 2D · 小孔投影模型 · 本地构建
world.question: 树荫下，为什么落着一地小太阳？
world.hook: 控制叶隙直径和日食遮挡比例，让树叶之间的天然针孔把太阳的形状投到整片地面。
world.payoff: 每一道足够小的叶隙都是一台针孔相机：它把太阳倒立成像，所以日偏食时，平日的圆形光斑会一起变成月牙。

en.title: Narrow one leaf gap and scatter a hundred tiny Suns across the ground
en.posterTitle: Why is the shade beneath a tree filled with tiny Suns?
en.posterHook: Let the Moon bite into the Sun, then narrow the gaps: more than a hundred blurry circles snap into crisp golden crescents.
en.question: Why is the shade beneath a tree filled with tiny Suns?
en.hook: Control leaf-gap diameter and eclipse coverage, turning the canopy’s natural pinholes into a field of projected solar images.
en.payoff: Every sufficiently small leaf gap is a pinhole camera that forms an inverted image of the Sun. During a partial eclipse, ordinary round patches all become crescents.
